relation.scope: Published experimental evidence from selected constructs. No project-run experiment, causal ablation, prospective success-rate estimate or Atlas benefit is demonstrated.

construction_decision.decision: Represent substrate identity, intended bond, observed cleavage positions and assay context separately before extracting transferable recognition constraints.
construction_decision.consequence: Do not treat the two TDP campaigns as a matched fixed-site comparison, count a selected lead as a cohort hit rate, or call target-activity gain a specificity switch.
construction_decision.scientific_question_open: Which recognition constraints can change target preference while retaining productive geometry at the same pre-specified bond?

structure_scope: No TDP-construct coordinates or productive-geometry evidence are represented in this record. Diffusion methods identify design provenance; they do not establish an experimentally observed catalytic state.
